title: Testers, bugs &
lede: The loop: backload test data → invite a small tester group from Discord → they stress-test chat and search → reports → triage → fix → next round.

items.title: Tester program
items.text: Selected Discord members get a **Tester** role and a private testers channel to discuss and ask questions. Group size is set by the dev leads per round. Testers file bugs with the template below.

items.title: Triage
items.text: Each report becomes a GitHub issue with a priority (P0–P3), an area (globe, search, chat, profile, projects, onboarding) and a lane (frontend / backend), then goes to whoever has hours. Major bugs first.

# commit small, push daily

# open a draft PR on day 1, link the issue
# Vercel builds a preview link per branch
# review → approved at review call → merge
# never push straight to main

items.title: Apply · ~10 min
items.text: Name, email, city, Discord handle, lane, languages and tools, years building, hours per week, best project link, and one open problem with a rough plan.

items.title: Short call
items.text: 15–20 minutes with Vishav about their work and where they'd fit.

items.title: Sign the agreement
items.text: Confidentiality, IP assignment, non-compete, confirmation the work is unpaid. Signed before any access.

items.title: Dev access
items.text: Repo access and development keys through a shared password vault. Nobody touches production data.

items.title: First PR
items.text: A scoped starter task inside a mob, reviewed before it merges to main.
